title: COPLANAR flags rotated neighbours (rails, planks) that never touch
summary: COPLANAR pairs by world AABB, so diagonal rails or rotated planks at one height are flagged. Merge rails into one mesh, alternate plank heights 1.2 cm; never dodge by changing contacts.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: rails = one mesh: merged([-1, 1].map(s => box(len, .1, .12).translate(0, 0, s * gauge / 2))); planks: y + (i % 2) * .012

doc.when: Parallel thin rotated parts at the same height.
doc.avoid: Raising one rail 1 cm to dodge it: the cart's wheels sank into it and it read as floating.
gotchas: Engine fix wanted: oriented boxes / mesh-local extents for the pairing.

problem.symptom: COPLANAR between the two rails or between neighbouring deck planks.
problem.cause: Rotated thin parts at one height overlap in world AABB although they never touch.
problem.fix: Merge into one mesh; or alternate heights by ~1.2 cm where nothing rests on them.
problem.detect: COPLANAR naming two parallel parts that are visibly apart.
